finding.title: Reconcile the Rule 2 barrel filename (providers.dart vs Y.dart) and fix the dead cross-feature-import checker
finding.rule: Rule 2 (cross-feature deep-import ban) + Rule 0 (deterministic checker requirement)

evidence.quote: match($$1, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, a); match($$0, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, b); if(a[1] != b[1]) print
the feature's public surface file `lib/features/Y/providers.dart`. If that file does not exist yet...
the barrel file `lib/features/Y/Y.dart` (the feature's public surface).

finding.why: The two docs governing Rule 2 name different sanctioned barrel files (providers.dart vs Y.dart), and no lib/features/*/providers.dart exists anywhere in the repo, so nobody can currently tell which convention is authoritative. The only mechanical check (make audit 15/15) has an awk bug: it matches `features/([^/]+)/` against both $1 (the file path) and $0 (which starts with that same file path), so a[1] always equals b[1] and the WARN branch can never fire -- confirmed empirically (0 output against 478 real cross-feature deep imports repo-wide, reproduced live against a genuine violation line). learning_screen.dart deep-imports 5 files across 4 other features; one of them (tutoring.dart) is a fully populated, correct barrel that already exports the exact symbol imported -- proving compliance was free and simply wasn't checked. A rename inside tutoring/dashboard/profiles/scheduler internals will silently break learning_screen.dart with zero warning at review or CI time.
finding.recommendation: Pick one barrel filename convention and update the other doc to match (or state a formal migration plan); fix the Makefile awk to compare the SECOND features/.../ match in the grep line (the import target), not the source path against itself; route learning_screen.dart's tutoring import through features/tutoring/tutoring.dart; either populate dashboard.dart/profiles.dart/scheduler.dart/learning.dart or apply coding-standards.md's documented fallback (route through a core provider/service).
acceptance_criteria: Adding a synthetic cross-feature deep import to a throwaway fixture makes `make audit` check 15/15 print WARN/fail; removing it restores a clean pass
learning_screen.dart's tutoring import resolves through features/tutoring/tutoring.dart
coding-standards.md and learning_tracker/CLAUDE.md name the same barrel file pattern for Rule 2
